verdict.rationale: Bruno is a local-first, open-source desktop/CLI tool that stores collections as plain files on the filesystem with no cloud account, sync, or login required, and ships an official Docker image and npm CLI so it can be fully self-hosted/run locally including in CI pipelines. This is corroborated by hands-on CLI probe and community reports of running it fully offline with git-based collaboration. missing for 10: no explicit self-hosted 'server/team' deployment docs (e.g., self-hosted sync server) and no independent report of self-hosting the full stack beyond desktop/CLI use.
